title: PADDLES UP! SWEET VS SALTY SHOWDOWN
lines: 01 LIMITED SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: November 6, 2025, 04:00 - November 16, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 7 days to receive generous rewards, including Emergency Sanity Concentrate, Orundum, Materials, and more. Participate in the first 5 days of the Support event to receive furniture rewards matching your preferred flavor.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate* 1, LMD* 30000
Day 2: Orundum* 200, Recruitment Permit* 5
Day 3: Chip Catalyst* 1, Tactical Battle Record* 20
Day 4: Data Supplement Stick* 10, Emergency Sanity Concentrate* 1
Day 5: Skill Summary - 1* 30, Expedited Plan* 5
Day 6: Furniture Part* 30, Pure Gold* 20
Day 7: Module Data Block* 1, Skill Summary - 2* 20
Note:
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
- Your taste preferences will affect which style your furniture comes in (Sweetsalt Liberal Doctors will get the reward of the winning side). Only one piece of furniture can be obtained.
